description: This file defines a Flutter widget for displaying a top headline card in a news app. It includes the TopHeadlineCard widget, which presents an image and headline text, and a private _HeroImage widget for handling image display with placeholder and error states.

classes.name: TopHeadlineCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a news article thumbnail with headline text and handles tap events.

classes.name: _HeroImage
classes.description: A private stateless widget responsible for rendering the article image with fallback placeholders and error icons.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for TopHeadlineCard and _HeroImage widgets.
